# Tourist Places
Filter: All Historic Recreational Religious

Coimbatore District is very much known for its tourist attractions. There are number of places to visit in and around Coimbatore.

Some of the major attractions of Coimbatore District such as Valparai Hill Station, Aliyar Dam and Kovai Coutralam are listed below. All these places are worth visiting.
